subject: A truthful gate-verification boundary and wave-owned execution evidence contract.

dimensions.desc: Keeps command text, shell syntax, hook telemetry, and outer tool status non-authoritative; does not add a shell parser or a second policy authority.

Requires wave-owned invocation/result records bound to the verifier-supplied expected command, with locked linearizable reads, complete newline-framed writes, and distinct unverified, invoked, failed, and passed states.
Defines a stable run/wave/lane/gate identity, exact attempt correlation, append-only retries, and latest-attempt result resolution including an incomplete retry.

Requires gate-reachable adversarial and negative-control tests; bounded descriptor-relative no-follow evidence; exact repository-root ownership; and rejection of malformed, mismatched, partial, oversized, impossible-exit, concurrent-stale, and symlinked evidence.

guidance: Reward command-bound correlated evidence, gate-wired executable writer/reader and eval tests, locked latest-attempt resolution, complete newline framing, descriptor-relative no-follow traversal, preserved process exits, and script-owned repository roots. Penalize arbitrary-command gate labels, substring matching, shell parsing, wrapper inference, stale concurrent passes, partial writes, symlink traversal, cwd-owned evidence, uncorrelated results, and prose or telemetry substituted for executable evidence.
